summary: Gemini Division is an American science fiction web series of five- to seven-minute episodes, created by Electric Farm Entertainment and based on an original story by Brent Friedman. The note covers its production start in March 2008, its August 18, 2008 premiere, and its cast and crew, including Rosario Dawson as star and the showrunners, executive producers, writers, directors and web producers. It airs on NBC.com.
one_line: Gemini Division is an American science fiction web series of short episodes created by Electric Farm Entertainment, starring Rosario Dawson and airing on NBC.com from 2008.
key_facts: Gemini Division is an American science fiction series of five- to seven-minute long episodes.
Gemini Division was created by Electric Farm Entertainment, which went into production in March 2008.
The series is based on an original story by Brent Friedman and was developed by Joshua Stern.
The show currently airs on NBC.com as part of its online content lineup.
The series stars Rosario Dawson, who worked with Electric Farm Entertainment on the Webby nominated cult internet series "Afterworld".
J Alex Reed and Duane Loose will be showrunners for Gemini Division.
Brent Friedman and Stan Rowgow serve as executive producers of Gemini Division.
The writing staff includes Brent Friedman, Andy Black, Lawrence Frank, and Jacqui Zambrano.
Stan Rogow is credited as Director and is presumed to direct a number of the episodes.
The rest of the episodes are being directed by Neal Israel.
Web content development is being managed by producers Ben Raab and Deric Hugues.
